name: airship_mpi
title: MPI 5 m Outdoor Blimp
docs_note: Its envelope is that of the 5 m outdoor blimp of Price et al. ([Simulation and Control of Deformable Autonomous Airships in Turbulent Wind](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-95892-3_46), 2022) as its open simulation model gives it (5.0 m x 2.0 m, 10.47 m³); the pods, fins and masses follow this family's rules, not that vehicle.
notes: Price, Liu, Black, Ahmad 2022 (IAS 2021, DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-95892-3_46) and Liu et al. IROS 2022 (DOI 10.1109/IROS47612.2022.9981182): 5 m, 10 kg, two thrust-vectoring motors on one axis, four fins with servo rudders/elevators, a tail motor on the lower fin. Read from the open model robot-perception-group/airship_simulation blimp_description/urdf/description_property.xacro (2026-10-08 clone): radius_blimp_body 1.00, length_blimp_body 5.00, volume 10.472, motor stick 0.75 m (motors at +-0.375 m), fin 0.55 + rudder 0.30 m chord x 0.48 m, gondola 0.42 x 0.16 x 0.20 m, body mass 4.622 kg with gas; its motor constant 3.7e-3 at 879 rad/s (2.9 kN) is not a thrust and is not used. ASSUMED: thrust 6 N per pod, pods independent (the vehicle tilts both motors on one axis), fins by the stability rule at the model's 0.85 m chord and 0.35 flap fraction, masses (gondola 7.74 kg keeps the envelope at 0.1312 kg/m^2). No tail motor here.
